definition: Armitron is the consent-gated time, continuity, authentication-state, browser coordination, multi-scale recall, and receipt umbrella for JP's MATADATA Digital Human system.

responsibilities: chronograph, countdown, interval, alarm, and second-timezone modes

pressureStages: full ordinary confirmation or protected handoff

digitalHumanSystem.purpose: A symbolic, user-controlled software and accessibility layer that coordinates declared intent, authorized context, browser interaction, recall, and receipts under JP authority.

authenticationSystem.nativeAppTarget: remote ChatGPT MCP app with OAuth 2.1 protected-resource discovery

recallSystem.name: Armitron Microscope Recall
responsibilities: zoom from project outcome to individual event
zoom out from event to mission meaning
separate observation, user report, inference, and provider confirmation
recallSystem.storage: encrypted append-only local notes; public receipts contain hashes and pointers, never note text

laneSystem.rule: Every consequential lane action records Armitron timing, authority, consent, authentication, result, and readback state.

humanOnlyGates: final consequential action when bound to legal, identity, billing, or irreversible effects
nonClaims: no provider affiliation or partnership without provider evidence
no physical atomic or ionic clock traceability without a verified connection
truthLaw: User report is not provider readback.
Prepared code is not a deployed or connected app.
OAuth design is not an OAuth grant.
Enterprise signup is not organization connector visibility.
Marketplace readiness is not listing approval.
Exact integer precision is not physical accuracy.
Full pressure is ordinary confirmation or protected handoff, never protected authorization.
